Frequently Asked Questions About Hiring Scala Developers

What does a Scala developer do?

Scala is a powerful tool, that’s why skills of Scala developer can vary. But most commonly, these developers specialize in building and maintaining software applications using Scala programming language. It’s known for scalability and functional features. They have a background in Scala to build backend systems. They also create high-performance APIs, and implement scalable distributed applications using frameworks like Akka, Play Framework, and Apache Spark. We can help you hire Scala engineers via a dedicated team model, or by engaging them as part-time developers.

What qualifications should I look for in a Scala developer?

Look for deep knowledge of Scala language, functional and object-oriented programming paradigms. Background with Scala unique features, such as immutability and pattern matching, is crucial. Also, a developer must have experience with Scala ecosystem and popular frameworks like Akka, Play Framework, and Apache Spark. Scala developers must also have a strong understanding of microservices architecture. Also, RESTful APIs, database management systems (SQL and NoSQL), big data and distributed systems. This also includes testing and debugging, strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

What are the benefits of hiring Scala developers from Mobilunity?

If you’re looking to hire Scala developers with maximum dedication and retention, we can help you. We’ll ensure a seamless integration into your team of developers. Our senior software developers will remain focused on your project goals. We specialize in connecting businesses worldwide with top-tier Scala developers. And we’re taking care that your team has the right skills and technologies to meet your requirements. Our engineers are accustomed to working in distributed teams. They can collaborate effectively across different time zones. This makes them a perfect fit for global Scala development projects. Additionally, we offer flexible engagement models. Choose between full-time Scala developers, FLEX part time specialists, or a professional Scala development team. We take all administrative burden, allowing you to focus solely on project success.

How do I hire Scala Developers from Mobilunity?

Start by reaching out to Mobilunity to discuss your specific requirements. Tell us about your project – so that we can understand your goals, timelines, and preferred engagement model. Based on your requirements, we tap into our extensive global network of Scala developers. Our recruitment team identifies candidates with the right expertise in Scala frameworks, tools, and programming techniques. We ensure a strong match for your project. You’ll have the opportunity to review their resumes, portfolios, and qualifications. And you can meet them during online interviews. Choose your hiring model – dedicated developers or a FLEX model for smaller tasks.

How much time will it take to hire skilled Scala Developers?

The timeline for hiring Scala developers with us depends on your specific project requirements. This includes team size / composition, and the complexity of the role. However, Mobilunity’s efficient and streamlined recruitment process ensures that you can onboard highly skilled Scala developers in a matter of weeks. Eventually, we will hire your Scala developers in around 3-6 weeks. From the initial consultation – to the developer(s) starting work on your project. This is significantly faster than traditional hiring. Thanks to the well-established recruitment pipeline we’ve been polishing for over 14 years.

Do you provide help with Scala developer technical interviews?

Yes, we do. Assessing technical expertise and ensuring a good fit with your company’s culture may be challenging. Especially when you lack Scala expertise within your in-house team. We can help you prepare and run role-specific coding tasks. This is accompanied with real-world problem-solving abilities. It also includes evaluating the knowledge of the candidates in functional programming, microservices architecture, and big data tools. If you need additional involvement, we can facilitate and participate in technical interviews alongside your team.

Why should my business choose Scala for its development projects?

Scala is a modern programming language. It’s particularly well-suited for building backend systems, real-time data processing pipelines, and distributed Scala applications. A seamless integration of Scala and Java allows businesses to leverage existing Java libraries and tools. This ensures compatibility while improving efficiency. With frameworks like Akka, Play Framework, and Apache Spark – Scala is also a go-to choice for companies handling big data, real-time analytics, or microservices architectures. Scala developers can bring a lot of innovations, and demand for Scala is rising.

Can my Scala developers work on both front-end and back-end development?

Although Scala is usually associated solely with back-end capabilities (i.e. building robust, scalable server-side applications and APIs) – its compatibility with frameworks like Scala.js allows developers to work effectively on front-end projects as well. Meaning that we can hire best Scala developers for you who will be able to write client-side code in Scala. Then it compiles into JavaScript – bridging the gap between front-end and back-end technologies.

What if you want to add or remove developers?

We understand that you may need to adjust the scope of work (or, for example, you experience changes in the timeline). So, our flexible engagement models are designed to make it easy to add or remove developers as required. The process of adding new people is typically smooth and efficient. We will identify the right candidates, interview them, and have them onboarded. And vice versa, if you no longer need the same number of developers – we can help you scale down your team under minimal disruption.
